goal: Replace explicit 2^n Boolean summation by one polynomial-time determinant, provided the SAT indicator can be localized into assignment-selected minors without cancellation.

selector_lemma.name: CAUCHY_BINET_EXACT_BOOLEAN_TRANSVERSAL_SUM_V0_3
setup: Let B be any 2n by n matrix over a commutative field/ring where determinants are defined.
Index rows of B as (i,b) with i in [n] and b in {0,1}.
Let A be n by 2n with both columns (i,0) and (i,1) equal to the i-th standard basis vector e_i.
selector_lemma.identity: det(A B) = sum_{a in {0,1}^n} det(B[S_a,:]), where S_a={(i,a_i):i in [n]}.
proof: Apply Cauchy-Binet: det(AB)=sum_{S subset [2n], |S|=n} det(A[:,S]) det(B[S,:]).
If S omits a variable pair or chooses two columns from one pair, A[:,S] has a missing or duplicated standard-basis direction, so its determinant is zero.
The only surviving S choose exactly one column from every pair; these are in bijection with Boolean assignments a.
For every surviving S_a, A[:,S_a] is the identity matrix in pair order, so det(A[:,S_a])=1.
selector_lemma.complexity: Given B explicitly, A and AB are constructible in polynomial time and det(AB) is computable in polynomial arithmetic time. No 2^n minors are materialized.

sat_route.required_object: For arbitrary 3-CNF F on n variables, construct in poly(|F|) time a 2n by n rational/integer matrix B_F of polynomial bitlength such that det(B_F[S_a,:]) is nonnegative for every assignment a and is positive iff F(a)=1.
consequence_if_constructed: By the selector lemma, det(A B_F)=sum_a det(B_F[S_a,:]).
All terms are nonnegative, so det(A B_F)>0 iff at least one satisfying assignment exists.
Thus SAT is decided by one polynomial-size determinant computation.
If every satisfying minor equals 1, det(A B_F)=#SAT(F), strengthening the route to exact counting.
sat_route.witness_reconstruction: If the decision construction exists and remains exact under fixing x_i=0 or 1, standard self-reduction reconstructs a satisfying assignment using O(n) determinant decisions, still polynomial.
sat_route.current_missing_lemma: UNIVERSAL_NONNEGATIVE_TRANSVERSAL_MINOR_REPRESENTATION_FOR_3CNF is NOT PROVED. This is the live constructive obligation, not an assumed subroutine.

padding_observation.statement: Adding polynomially many fixed mandatory rows/columns to the Cauchy-Binet selector does not by itself enlarge the zero/nonzero support class of assignment-selected minors.
padding_observation.reason: If any selected full minor is nonzero, the mandatory fixed rows are independent. Quotienting the ambient row space by their span reduces every selected full determinant to the determinant of the n variable-selected row images, up to one fixed nonzero scalar/basis factor.
padding_observation.scope: This concerns mandatory fixed padding only; more elaborate gadgets with additional optional choices or cancellations are not covered.

finite_falsifier.formula: NAE3(x,y,z) = (x OR y OR z) AND (NOT x OR NOT y OR NOT z)
finite_falsifier.method: Enumerate all 2^18 possible 6x3 GF(2) matrices and compare the eight assignment-selected 3x3 determinant values to the NAE3 truth table.
finite_falsifier.interpretation: The simplest selector representation already fails for a 2-clause 3-CNF over GF(2). This is field/model-specific, not a general impossibility theorem.
finite_falsifier.control: Over GF(3) the same NAE3 support IS representable; an explicit six-row control is stored in the checker. Therefore the GF(2) falsifier must not be promoted beyond its exact scope.

source_audit.source: Orzel, Srinivasan, Tavenas, Yehudayoff, The Algebraic Cost of a Boolean Sum, FSTTCS 2025
source_audit.relevance: Both permanent and determinant simulate formulas, but the paper proves alpha_perm(2)<=3 while alpha_det(2)=infinity for their simple-projection Boolean-sum cost. Therefore a naive constant-padding iterative determinant Boolean-sum closure is not available.

source_audit.source: Hrubes and Joglekar, On Read-k Projections of the Determinant, STACS 2025
source_audit.relevance: Read-k determinant representations have unconditional non-expressibility results; localizing every Boolean variable to few determinant entries is a genuine expressivity restriction, not a free normalization.

source_audit.source: Chaugule, A new characterization of VNP via Colored Determinant, ECCC TR25-214
source_audit.relevance: A colored determinant is VNP-complete and conditional-stack branching programs characterize VNP, confirming that determinant-like global cancellation can express Boolean-sum complexity only after adding structure beyond the ordinary determinant.

next_gate.name: E8_CHAR0_TRANSVERSAL_MINOR_SAT_INDICATOR_SEARCH_V0_4
next_gate.target: Either construct B_F over Q/Z with polynomial bitlength and nonnegative assignment minors exactly matching arbitrary 3-CNF satisfaction, or produce a field-independent explicit 3-CNF obstruction to this transversal-minor representation.
anti_loop: Do not return to fixed multiplicative quotient sketches (killed by v0.1).
Do not return to generic polynomial-dimensional linear/bilinear separator messages (killed by v0.2).
Do not claim determinant Boolean-sum closure by repeated constant padding; current literature explicitly blocks that simple route.
Do not infer impossibility of P=NP from failure of this candidate model.

scientific_ceiling.NEW_POSITIVE_MECHANISM: One determinant exactly sums all assignment-indexed transversal minors without enumerating assignments.
scientific_ceiling.MISSING: Polynomial universal construction of satisfying-assignment minors for arbitrary 3-CNF.
